purpose: First representation-only retrospective bridge from P0-S2B. Keep the exact historical rows, 40/20 roles, purely-local detector construction, step-max reducer, threshold objective, access tier and grouped bootstrap while replacing only the fitted family6 level risk curve with raw token entropy. The IU29 representation bridge remains unopened.

fixed_factors.evaluation_role: historical deterministic 20 percent audit per family
fixed_factors.answer_detector_construction: maximum of the same token-risk curve used by the locator
fixed_factors.threshold_objective: historical calibration-role ProcessBench macro F1 within each scorer cell
fixed_factors.threshold_tie_break: first maximum in stable descending risk sweep
fixed_factors.scorer_copy_grouping: same source-question draw carries both scorer copies
fixed_factors.supervision: labels only for the unchanged historical threshold and metrics

raw_entropy_contract.step_locator: token argmax mapped to known step span

bootstrap_contract: Paired source-question bootstrap. A family-unit draw carries both scorer copies and both S2B/S3A predictions; family estimates are averaged before the four-family macro contrast.
hard_fail_conditions: any registered S2B source, artifact, dependency, runner or registry hash differs
any S2B unit, target, locator, prediction, score, threshold or metric fails reconstruction within 1e-12
the 1270-row, 635-source-question population or its grouping hash changes
any factor besides the local-risk representation changes
raw token entropy is not used identically by both the max detector and step-max locator
the IU29 or any later split/population bridge is opened in the same run

mutation_boundary.method_fit: none for raw entropy; historical labels remain confined to threshold selection and metrics
